title: Stalks of extension by zero of an abelian sheaf on an open subspace
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $j:U\to X$ be the inclusion of an open subset, and let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $U$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Define the abelian presheaf $j_{p!}G$ on $X$ by $(j_{p!}G)(V)=G(V)$ when the open $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{p!}G)(V)=0$ otherwise, with the induced restriction maps. Let $j_!G$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For $x\in U$, the canonical map $G_x\to(j_!G)_x$ is a natural isomorphism of abelian groups; for $x\in X\setminus U$, the stalk $(j_!G)_x$ is zero. These identifications are natural in $G$ and identify the stalk at $x\in U$ of the adjunction map $j_!j^*F\to F$ with the identity of $F_x$ for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$; here $j^*F=F|_U$ is the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto F(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $F$, and the adjunction map is induced by the presheaf map $j_{p!}j^*F\to F$ that is the identity on $F(V)$ for $V\subseteq U$ and zero otherwise.

proof.text: Use lem-sc-abelian-open-extension-presheaf-stalk at each interior point to choose the canonical presheaf stalk isomorphism with its injection/germ formula. Compose it with asIso of stalkFunctor.map(toSheafify), using stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso. The stalkFunctor_map_germ identity then gives exactly the asserted abelianOpenExtensionSection germ formula.

Outside U, represent each element of the presheaf stalk by a germ using exists_germ_eq. Its neighborhood V cannot have an inclusion into U, since such an inclusion would put x in U. The direct sum over the empty inclusion type is subsingleton, so its section is zero and its germ is zero. AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton makes this stalk zero; transport along the sheafification stalk isomorphism to conclude for j_!G.

To prove naturality, use stalk_hom_ext and write every open W of U as the preimage of its open image V in X (Opens.map_functor_eq). The germ square reduces the assertion to naturality of abelianOpenExtensionSection. Before sheafification this is DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of for the componentwise map on the sole summand; after sheafification it is toSheafify_naturality. Associativity composes these identities.

For restriction, take Mathlib PresheafedSpace.restrictStalkIso for the underlying presheaf of F. Its germ formula followed by openImage_preimage_eq gives the specified r formula, transporting sections by eqToHom. The injection followed by abelianOpenCounit.app equals this eqToHom: toSheafify_sheafifyLift removes sheafification and DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of evaluates the presheaf counit on the unique injection. Check the final stalk equality by stalk_hom_ext on these germs and compose the inside-stalk germ formula, stalkFunctor_map_germ, the section/counit identity and the restriction germ formula.

lean.statement: theorem abelianOpenExtensionByZero_stalks (X : TopCat.{w}) (U : Opens X) : ∃ e : ∀ (x : U) (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)), TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (G.obj) x ≅ TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (((abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj G).obj) x.val, (∀ (x : U) (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) (V : Opens X) (hV : V ≤ U) (hx : x.val ∈ V), TopCat.Presheaf.germ (G.obj) ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj V) x hx ≫ (e x G).hom = abelianOpenExtensionSection U G V hV ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ (((abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj G).obj) V x.val hx) ∧ (∀ (x : U) (G H : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) (α : G ⟶ H), (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{w} x).map α.hom ≫ (e x H).hom = (e x G).hom ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{w} x.val).map ((abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).map α).hom) ∧ (∀ (G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U)) (x : X), x ∉ U → IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (((abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj G).obj) x)) ∧ (∀ (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{w} X) (x : U), ∃ r : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((abelianOpenRestriction U F).obj) x ≅ TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (F.obj) x.val, (∀ (V : Opens X) (hV : V ≤ U) (hx : x.val ∈ V), TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((abelianOpenRestriction U F).obj) ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj V) x hx ≫ r.hom = eqToHom (congrArg (fun W : Opens X ↦ F.obj.obj (op W)) (openImage_preimage_eq U V hV)) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ (F.obj) V x.val hx) ∧ (e x (abelianOpenRestriction U F)).hom ≫ (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{w} x.val).map (abelianOpenCounit U F).hom = r.hom)
